verdict.rationale: Lovable's project docs say each project includes the app's source code, 'which you can browse, edit, and download', and generated apps are described as 'backed by editable code', with Build-mode changes shown as file diffs. Together these directly support opening and editing the code inside the builder. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the in-builder code editor (navigation, editing workflow, plan or permission limits), independent or hands-on corroboration of editing code directly in the builder.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open and edit the generated source code directly inside the builder

citations.quote: Code: Your app's source code, which you can browse, edit, and download.
All modifications are visible through file diffs and summaries.
